events.verdict: Kispert (WAS) has his arms extended when he briefly engages with Yabusele (PHI) during the rebound, but the contact is marginal.
Kuzma (WAS) bats the pass from Kispert (WAS), which is not considered a dribble. He then brings both hands to the ball and legally starts his dribble.
Holmes (WAS) reaches across Yabusele's (PHI) front, initiating illegal contact that affects his SQBR.
Holmes (WAS) initiates contact with Maxey's (PHI) left arm in order to get to the ball, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Holmes (WAS) pursues the loose ball and the contact with Martin's (PHI) arm is marginal.

Yabusele (PHI) jumps alongside Butler's (WAS) path to the basket and legally contests the driving shot attempt. Trailing the play, Oubre Jr. (PHI) loses his balance on his own accord and any contact with Butler as the two players return to the floor is incidental.
Kispert (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position during Maxey's (PHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Gordon (PHI) deflects the pass out of bounds.
Yabusele (PHI) cleanly blocks the ball prior to any incidental contact occurring with Coulibaly (WAS).
Kispert (WAS) commits a take foul on Gordon (PHI).
Kuzma (WAS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Coulibaly (WAS) grabs and pulls Maxey's (PHI) jersey away from his body, affecting his FOM. The illegal contact occurs before the ball is inbounded and therefore correctly deemed an away-from-the-play foul.
Kispert (WAS) commits a take foul on Yabusele (PHI). The illegal contact occurs while Yabusele is in his shooting motion and therefore continuation should have been awarded.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) touches the ball last before it goes OOB.
